phrases: What happens if you stop sleeping?
Hour sixteen. You feel fine. Your brain doesn't.
You never let me file them.
Hour twenty-four. Your reactions are as slow as someone who's had a few drinks.
Why did we walk into the kitchen?
Day two. Microsleeps. Your brain switches off for a few seconds, even with your eyes open.
Day three. Some people start seeing things that aren't there.
I think the wall is breathing.
Then you finally sleep. Your body pays the debt back with extra deep sleep.
What should your brain survive next? Tell me.
